# set dir and filenames
```{r dir_file}
GIT_DIR <- "/w5home/bmoore/scRNAseq_downstream/src/" # getwd()
DATA_DIR <- "/w5home/bmoore/sequencing/MSpurgeon/HSCA/"
setwd(DATA_DIR)
#### make output dir  and read in data ####
timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
output <- paste0(DATA_DIR, "DEgenes_", timestamp)

```
# read in data
```{r read_in}
# load data
filename <- "HSCA_core.rds"
print("loading data")

# Import the file
seurat_obj <- readRDS(filename)
print(seurat_obj)
print(colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data))
```

# find markers between cell types
```{r markers}
merkel_ProlifKC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Prolif. KC")
# view results
head(merkel_ProlifKC.de.markers)
merkel_SpinousKC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Spinous KC")
merkel_BasalKC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Basal KC")
merkel_GranularKC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Granular KC")
merkel_CornifiedKC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Cornified KC")
merkel_FibroA.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Fibro A")
merkel_FibroB.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Fibro B")
merkel_FibroC.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Fibro C")
merkel_FibroD.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Fibro D")
merkel_FibroE.de.markers <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Merkel cell", ident.2 = "Fibro E")
```
# filter
```{r filter}
# make list
de.marker.list <- list(
    merkel_ProlifKC.de.markers, merkel_SpinousKC.de.markers,
    merkel_BasalKC.de.markers, merkel_GranularKC.de.markers,
    merkel_CornifiedKC.de.markers, merkel_FibroA.de.markers,
    merkel_FibroB.de.markers, merkel_FibroC.de.markers,
    merkel_FibroD.de.markers, merkel_FibroE.de.markers
)

names(de.marker.list) <- c(
    "merkel_ProlifKC", "merkel_SpinousKC",
    "merkel_BasalKC", "merkel_GranularKC",
    "merkel_CornifiedKC", "merkel_FibroA",
    "merkel_FibroB", "merkel_FibroC",
    "merkel_FibroD", "merkel_FibroE"
)

for (i in seq_along(de.marker.list)) {
    # filter to genes with adjusted p-value less than 0.05
    de.marker.list[[i]] <- filter(de.marker.list[[i]], p_val_adj < 0.05)
    # sort by log2 fold change
    de.marker.list[[i]] <- arrange(de.marker.list[[i]], desc(avg_log2FC))
    # write results
    write.table(de.marker.list[[i]], file = paste0(output, "/", names(de.marker.list)[i], "_de_markers.txt"), sep = "\t")
}
```
# plot umap
```{r umap}
# make cluster plots
plot1 <- DimPlot(seurat_obj,
    reduction = "umap", label = FALSE,
    pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "orig_celltype_lvl_3"
) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
plot2 <- DimPlot(seurat_obj,
    reduction = "umap", label = TRUE,
    pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "seurat_clusters"
)

# number of cell type categories, used to size the legend/plot area
n_celltypes <- length(unique(seurat_obj@meta.data$orig_celltype_lvl_3))

# make pdf - plots stacked so the long cell-type legend doesn't squeeze the UMAP panels;
# height scales with the number of categories so the legend has room without shrinking the plot
pdf(file = paste0(output, "/umap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8 + n_celltypes * 0.12)
print(plot1)
print(plot2)
dev.off()
```
